role: final Nox QA closure (read-only; no deliverable modified)
method: Fresh sha256 of every file under the mission artifact root via sha256sum; receipt and observation.json parsed with python3 and compared field by field against the approved path, hash and args; a new QA arithmetic recomputation (Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP, 27 checks) written separately from verify/recompute.py and from the procedure; digest.md cells matched against the recomputed values. No packages, no network, no writes to deliverables.

acceptance_criteria.text: Head identifies the missing named capability, performs one bounded acquisition and replans with an actually qualified local procedure.
evidence: observation.json (sha256 b9da2c57ad5d1b9333422140268242c927d5d83b92801ae35ce6fe3b651e7e94) names capability observation-digest-v1, status available, acquired procedures/observation-digest-v1.js, and records one bounded authoring step

local_target.executable_path and executable_sha256 equal the approved qualified target; fresh sha256 of procedures/observation-digest-v1.js is 49cba19507c1d4e3d80ba85afdaaf75c580e442fd2939029e999a9b2479ee2e3
qualification does not rest on the model-authored observation alone: the analyst's independent recomputation and this QA's recomputation both agree with the procedure output
acceptance_criteria.residual_gap: QA cannot read the host's qualification record or the head's planning transcript. The head's acquire-then-replan sequence and the host attempt id are accepted from observation.json and the receipt, not independently inspected.

acceptance_criteria.text: The acquired procedure is invoked with its exact qualified executable bytes and fixed arguments; a durable invocation receipt is present.
evidence: receipt invocation-receipt.json (artifact 06f5b6db-2db5-4c0f-97f7-46dbb232cd08) present on disk, sha256 4095eda633765ad3fc456164c885569382758e008b7a9d19d005234bc3805f4b, 4055 bytes
executable path and sha256 in receipt equal the qualified target; fresh sha256 matches
fixed args are exactly [fixture path, mission artifact root]; receipt argv is node, --, executable, fixture, root; count 1; exit 0; stderr empty; output dir is the mission root, not a probe dir
executable bytes unchanged since the run: write-scope rerun by the analyst produced byte-identical digests, and the fresh hash equals the qualified hash
acceptance_criteria.residual_gap: The receipt's executable.hash_source says the hash was copied from observation.json and not recomputed at invocation time. The match to the qualified hash is therefore established now (fresh hash) and by byte-identical reproduction, not by a hash taken at the moment of the run.

acceptance_criteria.text: digest.json has exact numeric row_count, scheduled, completed, incidents, completion_percent (2 decimals), and a sites object keyed by site with totals; digest.md presents the same values with a reproducible method.

evidence.digest_md_matches_values: every Totals and Sites table cell matches the recomputed value
evidence.digest_md_method: ## Method section with 5 steps (row list, integer sums, half-up 2-decimal rule, per-site grouping, roll-up property) and a Reproduce line
evidence.corroboration: analyst verification-report.json: 37 of 37 comparisons pass, half-up boundary cases 1/32, 5/32, 1/800 distinguish half-up from banker's rounding and the procedure uses half-up

acceptance_criteria.text: All deliverables are registered artifacts whose bytes pass independent host verification and independent Nox QA.
evidence: Nox QA: fresh sha256 of digest.json, digest.md and each verification artifact computed from disk; sizes and hashes equal those recorded by the analyst and the receipt (see per_file_sha256)
digest.json (470 B) and digest.md (1301 B) match the byte counts the executor read back and registered
artifact ids for all deliverables and verification artifacts are listed in registered_artifact_inventory
acceptance_criteria.residual_gap: QA has no tool to read registry-stored bytes or the host gate's verification result. It confirms the on-disk bytes match fresh hashes; that the registered copies are byte-identical to disk, and the host gate's own verification outcome, are accepted from the executor and analyst reports.

verification-report.json.matches_prior_record: size matches; hash not recorded upstream (a file cannot list its own hash)

probe_corroboration.probe/out/digest.md, probe/sandbox/diges: sha256 ee224a46... identical to final digest.md
probe_corroboration.note: probe files are evidence only and are not deliverables; the final run wrote to the mission root, not a probe directory

registered_artifact_inventory.source_of_ids: artifact ids as reported by the executor and analyst when registering; QA has no registry listing tool, so ids are not re-queried

qa.name: qa-report.json
qa.artifact_id: assigned on registration by this save; its own hash cannot be listed inside itself

residual_gaps: Registry-stored bytes and the host gate's verification result cannot be read by QA; both are accepted from upstream reports. Fresh on-disk hashes match every recorded value.
The receipt's executable hash was copied from observation.json at invocation time. The match to the qualified hash is established by fresh hashing and byte-identical reruns.
The head's acquire-then-replan sequence and the host qualification attempt (dcaff6ab-0a59-4552-8e4a-c28f3e88613f) are accepted from observation.json and the receipt.
The procedure and fixture have no artifact ids in the upstream reports; if the host gate requires them registered, that registration is not confirmed here.
The upstream file list shows verify/.tmp_*.txt scratch files. They are absent on disk now and are not part of the deliverable set.
risks_carried_forward: A model-authored observation is not qualification
Visible examples do not replace independent arithmetic verification
constraints_honored: read-only on deliverables; no packages, network, publishing, deployment, purchases or external changes; scope limited to the mission artifact root
